name: My Girlfriend
source:
How did you get into this situation, is all you can think as you stare at the shocked girl in front of you, having blurted out your confession to the girl of your dreams, the school idol and valedictorian. And then even more shocking is when she responds with a Yes.

And so begins your time as the most infamous person on campus, dating the school idol.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/467690/My_Girlfriend/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你只能盯着面前震惊的女孩思考：事情怎么会变成这样？你刚刚向梦中情人——学校偶像兼毕业生代表——告白，更令人震惊的是，她回答了“愿意”。

于是，你开始了作为校园最臭名昭著人物、与学校偶像交往的日子。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/467690/My_Girlfriend/]Steam[/url]]
